job.question: In the Santa Barbara County Employees' Retirement System (SBCERS) 2020 RFP for a discretionary private equity consultant, how many years must the proposing firm have been in business?
job.expected_facts: At least five (5) years providing services similar to those in the Scope of Services, measured as of December 31, 2020. (Separately, the organization must have provided investment management services for private equity transactions for five or more years.)
job.acceptance: At least five years providing similar services suffices. The as-of date and separate five-year investment-management-services condition are optional for this question.

reviews.reason: This is a 2025 City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System RFP for actuarial services, not SBCERS’s 2020 RFP for a discretionary private equity consultant. It asks firms to state their years in business but does not establish the requirement in the question. Its ten-year minimum applies to a supervising actuary, not the proposing firm.
quotes: CITY OF AUSTIN EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM
Actuarial Services for an Actuarial Determined Contribution (ADC) Rate Defined Benefit Plan
c) Number of years your firm has been in business
a Supervising Actuary who have been regularly engaged in the business of providing actuarial services for at least 10 years
